hero.title: A sponsor chosen for your channel
hero.lead: We find sponsors for small YouTube channels, and a person makes every match.

statement.text: Smallfold was created by a small channel, for small channels, to help them find sponsors. A person looks at your channel and chooses a sponsor that suits it.

items.title: Matched by hand
items.text: No automatic list, no algorithm. Every sponsor we suggest is picked by a person.

items.title: Only small channels
items.text: We work only with channels that have 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers.

items.title: You have the final say
items.text: You can turn down any sponsor we suggest. Nothing goes ahead without your yes.

process.label: The process
process.title: How a match is made
process.lead: From your application to a deal, in four steps.

steps.title: You apply
steps.text: Send us a link to your channel, what it is about and your subscriber count.

steps.title: We choose a sponsor
steps.text: We look at your channel and choose a sponsor to suggest.

steps.title: You decide
steps.text: You say yes or no to the sponsor, and the sponsor says yes or no to your channel.

steps.title: The deal is done
steps.text: With a yes on both sides, the deal goes ahead.

examples.label: Matches
examples.title: What a match can look like
examples.note: These are invented examples to show how a match works, and none of them is a real deal.

items.video: A sourdough video with a short section on the mill’s flour.

items.channel: A channel about restoring old bicycles
items.video: A full restoration, with the sponsor’s tools named as they are used.

items.sponsor: An online shop for pots and planters
items.video: A repotting guide that shows the sponsor’s pots in use.

commission.label: Commission
commission.title: No deal, no commission
commission.lead: Our commission comes out of your fee, and only once a deal is done.

band.text: Chosen by hand, one channel at a time

items.q: Do I have to look for sponsors myself?
items.a: No. Finding the sponsor is our work. Your part is to apply, and to say yes or no to what we suggest.

items.q: What if my channel has fewer than 1,000 subscribers?
items.a: It cannot join yet. We work with channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers, so apply once yours reaches 1,000.
For now, yes. Other platforms will come later.
